articles.title: Crew-12 readies for launch
articles.summary: Crew-12 is scheduled to lift off from the Kennedy Space Center in Florida, USA, no earlier than Wednesday 11 February.

articles.title: China launches reusable spaceplane on fourth secretive orbital mission
articles.summary:
China launched its experimental reusable spacecraft for the fourth time late Friday, once again maintaining strict secrecy around the mission.
The post China launches reusable spaceplane on fourth secretive orbital mission appeared first on SpaceNews.

articles.title: Live coverage: SpaceX to launch return to flight Falcon 9 mission following brief stand down
articles.summary: SpaceX halted launches for less than a week following an in-flight anomaly. Liftoff of the Starlink 17-33 mission is scheduled for 9:21 a.m. PST (12:21 p.m. EST / 1721 UTC).

articles.title: A Grand, Snow-Rimmed Canyon
articles.summary: A dusting of white highlighted the Colorado Plateau around the deep gorge, while shadows created a visual illusion.

articles.title: NASA seeks to bolster workforce, reduce reliance on contractors
articles.summary:
After losing about 20% of its civil servant workforce in the past year, NASA’s administrator says the agency plans to bring more expertise in-house and reduce its reliance on contractors.
The post NASA seeks to bolster workforce, reduce reliance on contractors appeared first on SpaceNews.
